call.text: The authors chose sinusoidal positional encodings because they hypothesized that the functions would allow the model to easily learn to attend by relative positions, since for any fixed offset k the encoding at position pos + k can be represented as a linear function of the encoding at position pos, and because the sinusoidal version may allow the model to extrapolate to sequence lengths longer than those encountered during training [AIAYN:3.5:c020]. The authors also experimented with learned positional embeddings and found that the two versions produced nearly identical results, with the learned version yielding a dev perplexity of 4.92 and BLEU of 25.7, matching the base model’s performance [AIAYN:3.5:c020][AIAYN:T3:r08][AIAYN:6.2:c031].
